summary.prose: In TypeScript and JavaScript, every call is now recorded with the nearest entity, even when it sits in no function: calls at the top of a file, in exported initializers and in export default go to the file, and calls in class field initializers and constructors go to the class. Every test('…', () => { … }) body is such a call, so test files reach the code they call. The code review also recognises Python, Go and JVM test files.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Record calls made in module-level statements, so tests reach the code they call

api.name: walkNode
api.signature: walkNode(node: SyntaxNode, source: string, repo: string, repoId: number, filePath: string, lang: Language, fileId: string, now: string, entities: Entity[], relations: Relation[]): void

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.purpose: The file entity id, also the caller of calls with no enclosing entity.

postconditions: A program-level statement that is not an import, function, class, interface, type alias or lexical/variable declaration (expression_statement, if/for/while/try/block/labeled) has extractCalls run over it with fileId as caller; the walk into its children continues as today.

For a lexical/variable declaration at program level or as an export_statement's declaration, each declarator whose value is not an arrow_function, function_expression or generator_function_expression has extractCalls run over its value with fileId as caller; function-valued declarators keep today's entity and caller.

An export_statement with a `value` (export default <expr>) has extractCalls run over the value with fileId as caller; an exported function or class declaration is walked as today and never scanned with the file as caller.
Calls inside function declarations, class methods and function-valued declarators are not also credited to the file unless they are nested inside a statement the file is credited for.

api.name: extractClass
api.signature: extractClass(node: SyntaxNode, source: string, repo: string, repoId: number, filePath: string, lang: Language, fileId: string, now: string, entities: Entity[], relations: Relation[]): void
postconditions: Each class-body field (public_field_definition) whose value is not a function has extractCalls run over the value with the class entity as caller.
The constructor's body has extractCalls run over it with the class entity as caller; the constructor still creates no entity of its own (the class covers it, as today).
Other methods keep their own entities and callers.

api.name: isTestFile

returns.meaning: True for the existing TS/JS conventions and also test_*.py, *_test.py, *_test.go, any src/test/ directory, *Test.java/.kt/.scala and *Spec.scala.

postconditions: Every path the current predicate accepts is still accepted; ordinary source files are rejected.

dataModelChanges.details: A CALLS (or CALLS_HTTP) relation from the TypeScript parser may now have the file entity (calls outside any function) or a class entity (field initializers, constructor bodies) as its source. No new entity kind, no new field, no store schema change.

migration.stateBefore: Per s1: the TS parser extracts calls only inside function declarations, class methods and function-valued declarators (src/indexer/parser/typescript.ts:259, :419, :552); program-level statements, exported initializers, export default, class field initializers and constructors are never scanned (src/indexer/parser/typescript.ts:150-200, :313-320, :385-388); isTestFile recognises only TS/JS test files (src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts:60-62).
migration.stateAfter: TS calls outside any extracted function are CALLS from the file or class entity; isTestFile recognises Python, Go and JVM test files.

migrationSteps.action: Add the program-level and export handling to walkNode.
Extract field-initializer and constructor-body calls in extractClass.
Extend isTestFile with the Python, Go and JVM test conventions.
Update and restart the installed daemon, then reindex the registered repositories so every TS file gains its new CALLS.

migration.backwardCompat: No store schema change and no new entity kind. Until a file is re-parsed it keeps its old edges, so a full reindex is needed for complete test links.

alternativesConsidered.name: Calls outside an extracted function go to the nearest entity
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: TS program-level, exported-initializer and export-default calls are CALLS from the file entity; class field initializers and constructor bodies are CALLS from the class entity; isTestFile learns the other languages.
alternativesConsidered.approach: walkNode extracts calls with the file entity as caller for a program-level statement that is not a declaration it handles, for each non-function declarator value of a program-level or exported lexical/variable declaration, and for an export_statement's `value` (export default <expr>); export unwrapping passes the module-level context into the declaration and never scans an exported function or class wholesale. extractClass extracts calls with the class entity as caller from each field initializer (a public_field_definition value that is not a function; a function-valued field keeps or gains its own handling unchanged) and from the constructor body. isTestFile also matches test_*.py, *_test.py, *_test.go, a src/test/ directory, *Test.java/.kt/.scala and *Spec.scala.
pros: No new entity kind and no store schema change.
Every TS test file reaches the code it calls; constructors and field initializers stop dropping calls.
cons: Calls in a nested named helper are credited to the helper and to the file.
Other languages wait for the Epic c2ba6fa6 Story.

alternativesConsidered.name: A synthetic entity per test call
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: As a1, but each program-level test('title', ...) becomes its own entity.
alternativesConsidered.approach: As a1, plus a new entity per recognised test-runner call named by its title.
cons: A new EntityKind with its graph-key byte mapping and a store schema step on the live v5 store; the review joins per file.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Adds a new EntityKind and a store schema step on the live v5 store for test-title granularity the code review does not use (it joins callers to the test record per file).

alternativesConsidered.name: Program-level statements only
alternativesConsidered.approach: The expression_statement part of a1 only.
cons: Exported initializers, export default, class fields and constructors keep dropping calls.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Partial on fixIntent-1: exported initializers, export default, class fields and constructors keep dropping calls.
